meta.name: hyperframes-media
meta.description: Audio and media assets for HyperFrames compositions, produced by one shared audio engine (`scripts/audio.mjs`) — multi-provider TTS (HeyGen / ElevenLabs / Kokoro local), background music + sound effects (HeyGen audio-library retrieval by default, with local Lyria / MusicGen BGM generation and a bundled SFX library as the no-credential fallback), Whisper transcription, background removal, and caption authoring. Use for voiceover / TTS, BGM, SFX / sound effects, transcription, captions / subtitles / lyrics / karaoke / per-word styling, voice + provider selection, and music-mood prompting.

copy.tagline: 为视频合成配音、背景音乐、音效和字幕
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为视频或动画添加语音、音乐和字幕。
copy.tagline_en: Add voiceovers, background music, sound effects, and captions to video compositions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add voiceovers, music, sound effects, and captions to video or animation compositions.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能生成配音、背景音乐、音效、字幕和歌词，还能去除视频背景。所有音频通过一个引擎统一处理，支持多种语音和音乐风格。
howto.when: 当你要求为视频或动画添加配音、背景音乐、音效、字幕，或去除背景时触发。

say.text: 给这段视频加个男声配音，语气要沉稳。
say.note: Claude 会生成配音并返回音频文件。

say.text: 为这个场景配一段轻快的背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会生成或检索背景音乐。

say.text: 把这段录音转成字幕，并加上卡拉OK效果。
say.note: Claude 会转录并生成带时间轴的字幕。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate voiceovers, background music, sound effects, captions, and lyrics, and remove video backgrounds. All audio is processed by a single engine supporting multiple voices and music styles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add voiceover, background music, sound effects, captions, or remove background for a video or animation.

say_en.text: Add a male voiceover to this video with a calm tone.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the voiceover and return an audio file.

say_en.text: Add a cheerful background music for this scene.
say_en.note: Claude will generate or retrieve background music.

say_en.text: Transcribe this recording into captions with karaoke effect.
say_en.note: Claude will transcribe and generate timed captions.
